source.title: The Funduk
source.summary: From makhzan to magazine: the trade infrastructure that connected three continents.
source.author: Islamic Economics
source.body_text: The word "magazine" comes from the Arabic makhzan, meaning warehouse. Step inside the medieval funduk, the complete trade ecosystem with warehouses, lodging, money changers, and translators. Explore the 3,000-strong caravanserai network, the waqf endowments that funded public infrastructure, and how Venice's fondaco district was inspired by Islamic institutional design.
